links.outcome: Privacy leakage via extraction, counterfactual memorization, and membership inference across four languages
links.effect: Privacy vulnerability scales with linguistic redundancy and tokenization granularity; Italian shows strongest leakage, English higher membership separability, French and Spanish more resilient.
links.quote: Results show that privacy vulnerability scales with linguistic redundancy and tokenization granularity: Italian exhibits the strongest leakage, while English shows higher membership separability.

unlisted_practices: Language-aware privacy-preserving mechanisms for multilingual LLM deployments

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates privacy vulnerabilities (leakage/extraction attacks) across different languages in medical LLMs, directly addressing AI safety/privacy risks in health data.
